text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —An exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Distinguished guests with long-standing 
ties to our clan will be coming to watch 
this time. ...I must deliver results that 
bring no shame.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Saphir, stay. ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be wise, be calm, be modest. You have 
followed my teachings well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Saphir. Until this race is over, I shall 
not return to the estate.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You will remember your etiquette during my 
absence and conduct yourself without 
causing trouble, correct?

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Very good.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good work. You're putting in a lot of 
effort today, too. Though it seems you 
haven't gone home recently...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Until I fulfill my duties this time, 
I have no intention of returning.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Go! Go! Milady!! Hype! Hype! 
Milaaaady~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Winning is a given. Furthermore, I must 
show results befitting the clan...!)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Maid
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Milady won her race! They're 
calling her 'an overwhelming, untouchable 
champion'!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Maid
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—now that the race is over, you'll 
finally get to see Milady again, Saphir.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text:
—Woof, woof, woof!! Pant, pant, pant, 
pant!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Saphir, stay. ...Calm yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
She is saying that going on walks with 
you, Ruby-san, brings her unbearable joy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real!? You speak dog!? Mountain girl, 
you're unreal~~~!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You haven't been able to see each other 
for a while, right? Saphir is just 
incredibly happy to see you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...However, she is acting far too 
differently from normal—

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Ngh!! Whimper... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? Wh-Wh-What happened to 
Saphir-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is... Let us rush to the veterinary 
clinic at once. Keep her in her collapsed 
posture, without moving her unnecessarily.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Saphir will surely be fine. She's a 
strong girl, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Dogs possess the vital force to 
endure and survive even harsh 
environments.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Good vibes injection~! That'll get 
Saphir-chan back on her feet in no time!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I had not paid attention to her all this 
time... I failed to fulfill my 
responsibility.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Even though I swore an oath on that day—)

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: —Woof, woof!!

text_block_list.name: Famous Breeder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, isn't she enthusiastic! It seems 
this little one has taken quite a liking 
to you, Lady Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Famous Breeder
text_block_list.text:
Haha, isn't she! She's completely attached 
to you. Why not take her home and live 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As one welcomed into our clan, I swear to 
take full responsibility and care for you 
throughout your life.

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I promise you a happy life, lacking for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Whimper... *lick lick*

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now now... cease that. ...First, we must 
begin with discipline befitting our clan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—san. Saphir-chan's owner, please enter 
the consultation room.

text_block_list.name: Veterinarian
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the cause of her collapse— she 
was simply so overjoyed to see you after 
so long that the intense excitement 
overwhelmed her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Veterinarian
text_block_list.text:
It is a condition called 'situational 
syncope.' It seems the excessive 
excitement placed too much strain on her 
body.

text_block_list.name: Veterinarian
text_block_list.text:
There were no convulsions, and she has 
fully regained her energy now, so please 
just keep an eye on her during your 
everyday routine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... she is already back in top form. 
What a relief, Saphir-san.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Saphir-chan is crazy energetic again! I'm 
so glad, Milady!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ruby. We'll head on ahead. Take your 
time coming back with Saphir.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: ? Whimper?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I was on the verge of breaking my 
'oath.'

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even though I promised to take care of you 
for life, and swore to ensure your 
happiness—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Saphir, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You have mastered the conduct worthy of a 
member of the "Illustrious Clan." This red 
ribbon is proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Awoo!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter with my hair...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Indeed, it matches mine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For the dog show this weekend, nothing 
less than victory is expected of us. Let 
us deliver the expected results.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Saphir. If it is you, you will surely 
succeed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My lessons will increase starting next 
week. Please go on walks with the maid on 
Wednesdays and Fridays.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
On other days, we will walk together as 
always... I promise.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Next spring, I will enter Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Dormitory life will begin, so I will no 
longer be able to see you every day, 
Saphir, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will return regularly. Do not trouble 
the household staff.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —...Good girl.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Our time together has diminished with 
each passing year. Even this time, I could 
not come see you for a long duration.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Saphir.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yet, we are of the "Illustrious Clan."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have a duty to continue demonstrating 
results in the racing world for the sake 
of the clan.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I shall likely become even busier than I 
am now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Even so, I promise you once more.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will properly secure time to spend with 
you, and keep your happiness in my 
thoughts at all times.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Saphir...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A gentle wind, isn't it? Calm, and so 
warm...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A beloved breeze.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My sincere apologies for keeping you 
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Let us go home, Saphir. —Together.
